- parcel-tracker = Vienna warehouse shipment tracking (Node 24 runs TS directly, no build, zero deps). User gives tasks one by one, works autonomously, reviews everything at the end (user).
- Done so far (all uncommitted, 105 tests green): ERP payload field names fixed; debounced JSON store writes (store.ts: 200 ms window from first mutation, flush(), flushOnExit wired in server.ts; test/store-debounce.test.ts); request logging (router.ts, one `request` line: method, path w/o query, status, duration_ms; test/request-log.test.ts); list ETA (GET /shipments only); Austrian holidays in ETA; ATP S10 validation; ERP webhook signing; ERP retries.

## Decisions
- ERP retries (notify.ts postToErpWithRetry): 3 attempts total, fixed 30 s pause, no backoff, retry only network errors/timeouts/5xx (not 4xx — my choice); sleep injectable (user). Reason: ERP dedups by event_id only within 2 min; worst case last attempt starts at 2*(30s+5s timeout)=70s; a test guards this budget (raising delay/attempts/timeoutMs can break it). Notifier is fire-and-forget (`void notify`), retries never delay HTTP responses; retries are in-memory, lost on restart.
- ERP signing: top-level body field `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 over JSON body WITHOUT sig (sig appended last, key order kept); secret only from env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET (user). If unset: send unsigned + one-time warn (my choice; keeps local sandbox working, ERP will 401 once ERP-1182 enforces).
- Austrian holidays: hardcoded 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts — because deployment has zero outbound internet (user). Easter-based dates computed by me, user should verify; 2028+ must be added.
